description: Schema-analysis variants: BigInt id used as cursor with readonly and strict per-field encryption modes and a default-config hash (empty normalize list); String @id used as cursor; an explicit @encryption:cursor annotation pointing at a unique String field overriding the id; a self-referential relation (list and non-list connections to the same model); a hash annotation with multiple normalize options plus an algorithm override; and a plain model with no encrypted fields or connections.

input.datamodel:
model Account {
  id        BigInt  @id @default(autoincrement())
  secret    String  /// @encrypted
  ro        String? /// @encrypted?mode=readonly
  st        String? /// @encrypted?mode=strict
  secretHash String? /// @encryption:hash(secret)
}

model Node {
  id       Int    @id @default(autoincrement())
  label    String /// @encrypted
  parent   Node?  @relation("tree", fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  parentId Int?
  children Node[] @relation("tree")
}
